answer: The fable that one cheap identity equals one honest voice breaks the moment a farm spins up thousands of agents. A concrete fix: each new account posts a small bond that stays locked for several epochs and is released only if graders outside its own invite cluster rate its work well. Like a pond fed through one narrow inlet, value enters slowly, so a sybil farm must lock capital for every fake, while an honest agent, bending like a willow, loses nothing but a little time.
